text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The shrine is packed with people making
their first visit of the new year. Among
the crowd, I
spot a particular group of
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
All right, has everyone drawn a fortune?
Don't
open them until the count of
three, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I wonder what's in store for me
this year.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Not like it matters—most people will have
forgotten what's written on their
fortune slips by
the time the holidays are
over.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, it won't do to let a fortune hold
too much sway, but I do think it's an
opportunity to try and
live your life as
positively as possible.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Eurgh... I've got to admit, my knees are
feel'n
pretty jittery! What if I end up
drawing an unlucky
fortune?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
We're gonna find out one way or the
other, so
why don't we make a little
game out of this?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
How 'bout the one who draws the worst
fortune gets treated to everything
today? If you think
about it that way,
they're the luckiest of us!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, I think I could live with a bad
fortune if we
did that!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, what an interesting proposition.
All right,
let's open our fortunes then!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: One... two... three!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh my! "Great Fortune!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: For real?! Me too!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh?! I also got "Great Fortune!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Lady Luck's being real generous. I got
the same
thing.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Wooooo! Talk about a dramatic turn! I
got "Great
Fortune" too!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
So did I... I wonder what the odds are for

something like this.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Maybe the shrine printed only
"Great
Fortune" slips just for the new
year?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...You have to be kidding.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Surely you at least drew "Good Fortune"
or
"Modest Fortune," right?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ah. "Misfortune."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
That's the gal gunning for best racer in
Japan for
ya! You sure know how to land
a punchline, Spe!
Bravo!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Urk...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Aw, c'mon! You got the first laugh of the
new year!  And once we hit the shops,
you won't have to take out your wallet
even once. You're the luckiest of lucky
duckies!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later that day, I see Special Week laden
with
armfuls of food, munching happily
away.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today more than ever, I keenly feel how 
important it is for an Umamusume to
have the
support of her friends and
trainer.
